merchantRefId.description: Indicates the merchant Reference Id. The reference ID is unique for each link.

custName.description: Indicates the Beneficiary name to which the link is to be sent.

expiryDate.description: Indicates the expiry date on which the smart send link will expire in yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.000Z format. By default, 7 days by default.

custMobile.description: Indicates the Beneficiary mobile number to which the link is to be sent.

custEmail.description: Indicates the Beneficiary email to which the link is to be sent.
